verdict.headline: SpaceX lockup selling confirmed; Dow at records while Nasdaq falls on insider supply
verdict.label: SPCX −13.6% lockup day one; Dow record; NQ −0.83%; memory complex (MU −3.4%) weighs tech; Hormuz unsigned; NFP tomorrow 8:30 ET; Sep hike 54%
verdict.rationale_short: SPCX's first 20% insider tranche is being sold — stock at ~$93, below the $135 IPO price — confirming the Q3 Starlink profitability thesis is not yet sufficient to hold insiders back. The Dow/Nasdaq bifurcation (Dow record highs, Nasdaq −0.83%) reflects size-specific supply weight rather than systemic risk; the 30Y at 5.20% remains the sole regime breach. NFP tomorrow at 8:30 AM ET (consensus 80-100K) is the only lever between the current 54% September hike probability and a direction. If SPX closes below 7,380, this read no longer holds.

watchlist_mentions.note: Lockup day one confirmed: −13.6% signals insiders are selling the first 20% tranche. Stock at ~$93, below the $135 IPO price and down 59% from the June $225 ATH. The diagnostic set up this morning — 50M shares stable = absorbed, 150M+ shares below support = front-running — has resolved toward the latter. December tranche expiry is now the structural floor. Q3 Starlink profitability confirmation (~October earnings) is the only catalyst that could interrupt the liquidation template before December.

−3.4% premarket (~$897). Memory complex in a bear market from July highs. Michael Burry put at $1,051.87 frames the institutional thesis. $880 is near-term support; $920 is where the selloff reverses to neutral. Key read-through: NVDA diverging from MU/SKHY means the selloff may be supply/pricing noise in the HBM tier below Vera Rubin rather than demand-pool. NVDA August 26 Q2 FY27 is the confirming event.

~$220, holding through the memory complex selloff. SpaceX's Vera Rubin exclusive (2GW year-end, 10GW 2027 target) established $216 as support. Divergence from MU/SKHY is the session's key signal: if AI hardware demand were peaking structurally, NVDA should be moving with memory; it is not. August 26 Q2 FY27 — gross margin above 76%, guide above consensus — is the level test.

~$484, second regular-session test of the floor identified in the August 4 morning brief. One close below $484 on normal volume is noise; a second close below with volume signals SpaceX's NVDA exclusivity has durably repriced AMD's AI-hardware competitive position. Conference-call Q3 gross-margin guidance (56%+) is the deciding datapoint. Two closes above $490 after a guide recovery confirm the washout was absorbed.

~$64,200 (+0.3%). Gate 2 ($62,000) buffer intact at $2,200. Oil deflation and steady 10Y are constructive. Equity risk-off is tech-specific — BTC is not tracking the SPCX or memory complex selloff. Cross-asset risk-off would require a simultaneous regime widening event, not currently in view.

trade_setups.asset: SPCX post-lockup structure — December tranche as the structural floor
trade_setups.thesis: The first-tranche selloff (−13.6%) is the diagnostic: insiders are not holding through the Q3 Starlink profitability setup. The staggered lockup structure means each subsequent tranche (post-Q3 earnings, December backstop) carries the same supply pressure unless a fundamental catalyst intervenes. A first-session close near $93 sets the template; the December backstop is now the structural floor rather than the Starlink thesis.
trade_setups.entry: First-session close near $93 is where the selloff crystallizes. Stabilization above $108 (pre-earnings close) after Q3 earnings would be the signal that the fundamental thesis is overriding lockup supply. A second session of high-volume selling below $93 would establish the December tranche as the next reference level.
trade_setups.invalidation: Q3 earnings (~October 2026) confirming Starlink profitability and AI revenue above $2B is the only catalyst that could reset the lockup-as-liquidation dynamic before December.
trade_setups.horizon: First-session read: today's close. Fundamental resolution: Q3 earnings ~October 2026.

trade_setups.thesis: The 30Y at 5.20% is the sole regime breach, holding for four sessions. The clearing path runs through NFP tomorrow (consensus 80-100K, prior 57K) and September hike probability moving below 45%. ADP's 44K — softest of 2026, well below 75K consensus — is historically directional for NFP at this magnitude of deviation. Oil deflation (WTI $74.69) has contributed its rate relief; the remaining compression is labor-data-driven.
trade_setups.entry: September hike probability within 30 minutes of the 8:30 AM ET NFP release is the leading indicator. Below 45%: 30Y compression thesis active toward 5.00%. Above 70%: 30Y extends toward 5.28% and the regime widens from 1-of-6 to 2-of-6. The 5.00% and 5.28% levels are where the current regime read either clears or worsens.
trade_setups.invalidation: NFP above 150K re-prices September toward 65%+, extending the sole breach further. ISM Services prices-paid above 65% would add an inflation layer that could prevent 30Y compression regardless of the headline jobs number.
trade_setups.horizon: NFP release: tomorrow 8:30 AM ET. 30Y resolution: mid-August.

trade_setups.asset: Memory complex vs NVDA — AI demand thesis diagnostic
trade_setups.thesis: MU (−3.4%), SKHY (−6.1%), and SNDK (−9%) are in bear-market territory from July highs on the AI CapEx peaking narrative. NVDA at ~$220 has not participated in the selloff. The divergence either means (a) the memory selloff is supply and pricing noise specific to the HBM layer below Vera Rubin, or (b) NVDA has not yet priced the same demand risk. NVDA's August 26 Q2 FY27 earnings is the definitive event for resolving which case is true.
trade_setups.entry: MU $880 is near-term support; $920 is where the selloff stalls and the move becomes neutral. The levels that define whether the divergence resolves bullishly (NVDA guide flat-to-up on Aug 26, memory bear isolated) or bearishly (NVDA guide conservative, divergence closes downward) are the August 26 datacenter revenue and gross margin numbers.
trade_setups.invalidation: NVDA selling through $216 before August 26 would close the divergence to the downside and confirm the AI demand concern extends beyond the memory tier.
trade_setups.horizon: Near-term sentiment: 1-3 sessions. Fundamental confirmation: NVDA earnings August 26.

bear_case: The SPCX lockup is not mechanically absorbing: insiders are not treating the AI-infrastructure narrative as a reason to hold at $93. If this signals that well-positioned participants are monetizing because capex payback timelines are uncertain, the MU/SKHY/SNDK selloff and the SPCX unlock are the same trade expressed across two sectors — AI hardware supply is being de-risked at the most-informed tier. NVDA not selling off is the bull side's only read-through; that divergence collapses if NVDA moves through $216 today. NFP above 130K tomorrow re-prices September toward 65%, returning the September trigger and making the regime 2-of-6. SPX closing below 7,380 invalidates this morning read entirely.
